about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: AI Developer & Agent Architecture on Google Cloud
about.p1: I'm an AI Developer at Gentrop and an Information Systems undergraduate at UNISANTA, officially certified by Google Cloud as a Generative AI Leader and Partner Specialist in Gemini Enterprise (Agent Development & Deployment).
about.p2: Day to day, I design and build multi-agent systems in Python using Google ADK (Agent Development Kit), Google Cloud Agent Platform and Gemini Enterprise (Agentspace). I build custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, RAG pipelines, integrations with REST APIs and SQL (BigQuery), serverless deployments on GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Secret Manager) and web interfaces with TypeScript, HTML and CSS.
